title: Swift stdlib conformance facts
description: Facts feeding ConformanceOracle for Swift standard-library types that have no local TypeDecl: the curated type keys × the curated protocol axis, reconciled with the live stdlib by `nuke regen-stdlib-conformances`. Curate the keys and the axis; do not hand-edit entries.

protocols.description: The curated protocol axis: the module-qualified protocols the table answers about.

conformances.description: Map of module-qualified stdlib type name to the module-qualified protocols it conforms to.
